subject: Short endorsement & 10m sync — CartMate pilot KPIs
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Doyle <alex.doyle@cartmate.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-01-10T15:12:00-08:00
Subject: Short endorsement & 10m sync — CartMate pilot KPIs

Hi Alex,

Thanks again for running the POC with us last month — the engineering team and I really enjoyed working with you and the CartMate ops crew. I wanted to pass along a short metrics recap from the run and ask two quick favors if you’re open to them.

High-level results (pilot: checkout flow, 3-week window):
- Avg inference latency (95th pctl): 48 ms (down from ~320 ms baseline)
- Cost per 1M tokens served: ~$85 (pilot quant + batching reduced unit cost by ~42%)
- Throughput: sustained 750 reqs/min at 8k-concurrent sessions (vs 220 reqs/min baseline)
- Error rate: 0.2% (3x lower than pre-integration)

Attached: cartmate_poc_kpi_summary.pdf (two-page deck) and token_consumption_samples.csv (anonymized traces).

Would you be willing to help with the following?
1) A one- or two-line quote we can use in a short micro-case on our site (example: “Redwood cut latency by X and reduced inference costs...” — but feel free to write it in your own voice).
2) A quick artifact for marketing: either a 30–60s recorded soundbite (phone/video) or a 10-minute call where we capture a short clip and ask a couple of contextual questions. We can record on our side and send you the draft before publishing.

If yes, we can also route a simple consent DocuSign for logo + quote permission. Proposed times for a 10-minute sync next week (your timezone):
- Tue 2027-01-12 10:00–10:20 PST
- Wed 2027-01-13 14:00–14:20 PST

If those don’t work, name two windows that do and we’ll adapt. Also looping Marissa (PMM) who’d shepherd the content piece.

Appreciate it — short customer stories go a long way in convincing other teams to try Redwood.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0187

Attachments: cartmate_poc_kpi_summary.pdf, token_consumption_samples.csv
From: Alex Doyle <alex.doyle@cartmate.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-01-11T09:05:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Short endorsement & 10m sync — CartMate pilot KPIs

Thanks Jasmine — great summary and congrats to the teams.

On Mon, Jan 10, 2027 at 3:12 PM Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Hi Alex,
> 
> Thanks again for running the POC with us last month — the engineering team and I really enjoyed working with you and the CartMate ops crew. I wanted to pass along a short metrics recap from the run and ask two quick favors if you’re open to them.

Happy to help. We’ll provide a short 1–2 line quote (I can have that to you by EOD Monday). For the clip, a 10-minute call next Tue 2027-01-12 at 10:00 PST works for me — please lock it in. I’ll be joined by Sara (Product) on the call to speak to business impact.

For the quote, here’s a quick draft you can edit/use: “Redwood helped us reduce latency and inference costs while improving throughput — the integration was straightforward and the team was responsive.”

I’m fine with the marketing consent; please send over the DocuSign and we’ll get legal to sign.

Thanks,
Alex Doyle
Head of Platform, CartMate
alex.doyle@cartmate.com
+1 (646) 333-2020
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Alex Doyle <alex.doyle@cartmate.com>
Date: 2027-01-12T11:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Short endorsement & 10m sync — CartMate pilot KPIs

Looping in a couple of operational asks so we have the right approvals in place.

On Tue, Jan 11, 2027 at 9:05 AM Alex Doyle <alex.doyle@cartmate.com> wrote:

Thanks Alex — great. Jasmine / Marissa, can you send across a short consent packet that covers: logo usage, brief quote, and rights to use a 30–60s clip across web and social? I’ve attached our standard reference consent template for legal as redwood_reference_consent_docusign.pdf — I can pre-fill the key bits and convert to DocuSign.

Also: procurement@cartmate.com — if you want anything tracked on the PO/marketing credits side, ping me and I’ll coordinate.

Rishi
Director, Customer Ops | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood_reference_consent_docusign.pdf
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>

Perfect — thanks all. Confirming the 10-minute sync for Tue 2027-01-12 at 10:00 PST (I’ll send a calendar invite and a short agenda). Alex, appreciate the draft quote — we’ll keep it light and send the final phrasing for sign-off before publishing.

DocuSign link (pre-filled): https://docusign.com/containers/abc123
Drive folder (assets): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0AFAKEP0

Agenda (10m):
1) Quick context (30s)
2) Alex — 1–2 lines on impact (60s)
3) Short clarification on metrics we might call out (2–3m)
4) Confirm permissions & next steps (2–3m)

Marissa will draft the landing copy and send a preview. Alex — if you can drop the signed DocuSign by EOD Thursday, we’ll schedule the editing session and publish the microcase next week.

Thanks again — excited to get this live.

Best,
Jasmine
Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
